identity_reason: it is Input inside InputGroup with a magnifier at its start and an IconButton to clear, composed from those parts
concept: A search field with a magnifier at its start and a clear button once there is a query; Enter searches and Esc clears.

glyph.why: the magnifier and the cross sit in the secondary tone so the query is read first

input.why: the browser cancel button is removed so the clear button is the one way to clear

idle.why: the clear button keeps its place while empty so the field does not grow when the first letter is typed

data-component=SearchInput.why: its controls fade colour and light on hover with the shared motion, so it answers like every control

background-color.why: background-color fades over the hover duration, never snaps

color.why: color fades over the hover duration, never snaps

box-shadow.why: box-shadow fades over the hover duration, never snaps

opacity.why: opacity fades over the hover duration, never snaps
